description: Create 4 polished social-media bios from your name, profession and interests in Professional, Funny, Minimalist or Inspirational tones. Click to copy.

faqs.a: Enter your name, profession and interests, pick a tone and click Generate. You get four different bios to choose from.
faqs.q: How does the bio generator work?

faqs.a: The four variants use different templates and reorder your interests, so you get genuinely different options each time.
faqs.q: Are the 4 bios different from each other?

faqs.a: Yes — all bios are generated from templates in your browser, so your details never leave your device.

howto: Add your interests, separated by commas.
Pick a tone: Professional, Funny, Minimalist or Inspirational.
Click Generate and copy your favorite bio.
title: Bio Generator
